claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs 9 to 12 November (2026).
Invest.Rio and Maravalley opened the call for startups in September 2026, as Startups.com.br reported on 18 September 2026.
Startups.com.br named the ten startups on 26 October 2026 and reported that Gol, as the mission's official airline, provides their tickets.
Correio da Manhã reported the same ten startups on 25 October 2026.
Gol opened its Rio de Janeiro to Lisbon route from Galeão in September 2026.
From 24 November 2026, Gol runs five flights a week on Rio to Lisbon, on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays.
Maravalley ran a similar mission to VivaTech in Paris in June 2026, with Business France's delegation.
This is the mission's second year; last year it also took ten startups to Web Summit.
Of the ten startups in Rio's mission, nine are from Brazil and sheerME is from Portugal.
Bizuu and AllPetSenior speak in Web Summit's Startup Showcase.
Sebrae says 12 Brazilian states run their own missions to this year's Web Summit.
Eighteen Brazilian founders and team members are on the Startup Showcase stages at Web Summit.
